name: nist-mcp
description: Provides structured access to the full NIST cybersecurity catalog, including SP 800/1800 publications, security controls, CSF 2.0, and the NVD database. It enables AI assistants to search and retrieve cybersecurity standards, CVEs, and compliance guidance directly from a local SQLite index.
